ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 75:25 ratio of high-intensity (white/off-white) to low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central low-intensity vertical band at the peduncle axis, bifurcating two large high-intensity white contiguous zones on the left and right lobes. Distributed low-intensity speckling and vertical striations are mapped across the lower-medial sections of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with an estimated pixel-based interior angle of 50-60 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with significant pixel-amplitude variations (jagged peaks) across the entire horizontal boundary from the medial notch to the lateral tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curve transitioning into a sharp upward sweep at the distal extremities of both lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Highly localized clusters of circular, high-intensity relief (yellow/white) at the extreme lateral tips of both the left and right fluke lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Parallel, low-intensity vertical lines (rake marks) observed on the white ventral field of the left lobe, extending from the trailing edge downward.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization present on the distal edges of both fluke lobes, creating a non-uniform, textured boundary.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique 'drip' pigmentation pattern where dark pixels from the trailing edge infiltrate the white ventral field in irregular vertical streaks.
